summary: Steep kerb where cars park, with homes 12-13 m away on the same side.
reasons: Cars already park along this kerb

best_section.where: West kerb of Manchester Terrace just north of the Rokeby Terrace junction

drivers.seclusion: Residential blocks 13 m from the kerb at the start and 12 m at 37 m; more homes within 25 m. Bush and trees to the north.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a parking strip; several cars parked along this kerb show room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street at a T-junction with a bend; low traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the west kerb, but No Stopping Any Time signs mark the nearby junction and bend.
